targetText:
Typical of the old capitalism, when free competition held
 undivided sway, was the export of goods. Typical of the latest
 stage of capitalism, when monopolies rule, is the export of
 capital.
summary: Under monopoly capitalism, exporting capital (loans and factory investments) replaces exporting manufactured commodities.
context: Exporting capital allows imperialist nations to harvest perpetual dividends and interest from less developed countries.

targetText:
surplus capital will be utilised
 not for the purpose of raising the standard of living of the
 masses in a given country
summary: Capitalists send surplus wealth abroad for higher profits rather than eliminating domestic poverty, which would lower profit rates.
context: Refutes reformist claims that capitalists could choose to invest surplus wealth humanely at home.

summary:
In these backward countries profits are usually high,
 for capital... this statement highlights key economic principles governing class relations under capitalism.
context: Essential theoretical analysis of capital, wages, and social relations.
